name: boldform-lite
description: Build tooling for the BoldForm Lite WordPress plugin (dev-only; not part of the shipped plugin).
author: Themewant

scripts.makepot: wp i18n make-pot . languages/boldform-lite.pot --exclude=build,node_modules,src,tests --slug=boldform-lite && sed -i.bak '/POT-Creation-Date/d' languages/boldform-lite.pot && rm -f languages/boldform-lite.pot.bak
scripts.build: npm run makepot && wp-scripts plugin-zip && { zip -qd boldform-lite.zip boldform-lite/package.json boldform-lite/README.md || true; } && rm -rf build && mkdir -p build && unzip -qo boldform-lite.zip -d build && mv -f boldform-lite.zip build/boldform-lite-$npm_package_version.zip
scripts.release: npm run makepot && { [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] || { echo 'Working tree is not clean (commit the regenerated translation template if it changed) - commit or stash before releasing.'; exit 1; }; } && npm run build
